items.title: My Pet
paragraphs: My name is Omar. I have a small dog. His name is Rex. He is brown and white.
Every day, I play with Rex in the garden. I give him food and water. Rex likes to run and jump.
Rex is my best friend. He sleeps near my bed at night. I love my dog very much.

items.title: My Favourite Food
paragraphs: My name is Lina. I love food. My favourite food is pizza. I like it with cheese and tomato.
On Fridays, my mother makes pizza for me. My father likes pizza too. We eat together as a family.
Sometimes we go to a restaurant. I eat pizza and drink orange juice. I am always happy at dinner time.

items.title: My Best Friend
paragraphs: Hello! My name is Khaled. I have a friend. His name is Sami. We are in the same class.
We play together every day. At school, we sit next to each other. We read and write together.
After school, we go to the park. Sami has a red bike. I have a blue bike. We ride and laugh together.

items.title: At the Park
paragraphs: On Saturday, I go to the park with my family. The park is big and green. There are many trees.
My sister and I play on the swings. My father sits on a bench and reads a book. My mother watches us.
We eat sandwiches and drink water. Then we walk home. The park is my favourite place.

items.title: My Birthday
paragraphs: My birthday is in July. I am twelve years old. My mother makes a big cake for me.
My friends come to my party. They give me nice gifts. I get books, a ball, and a new bag.
We play games and eat cake together. I am very happy on my birthday. Thank you, everyone!

items.title: My Room
paragraphs: I have a small room in our house. It is blue and white. There is a bed, a desk, and a chair.
On the desk, I have books and pens. On the wall, there is a clock and a picture. I like my room.
Every night, I read a story in my room. Then I sleep. My room is clean and nice.

items.title: My Day
paragraphs: My name is Yara. Every day, I get up at seven o’clock. I wash my face and brush my teeth.
Then I eat breakfast with my family. I drink milk and eat eggs. After that, I go to school.
In the evening, I do my homework. I watch TV with my brother. Then I go to bed at nine o’clock.

items.title: At the Beach
paragraphs: In summer, my family goes to the beach. The sea is blue and the sand is yellow. I love the beach.
I swim in the water with my brother. My mother sits under a big umbrella. My father takes pictures.
We eat ice cream and play in the sand. The beach is fun and warm. I want to go again!

items.title: My Favourite Colour
paragraphs: My name is Adam. My favourite colour is blue. I have a blue shirt, blue shoes, and a blue bag.
My sister likes red. She has a red dress and a red hat. My brother likes green. He has a green ball.
My room is white and yellow. But my favourite thing in my room is my blue fish. It is on my desk.

items.title: My Big Family
paragraphs: My name is Hala. I have a big family. My father, my mother, two brothers, and one sister live with me.
My father works in an office. My mother works at home. My brothers go to school like me.
On holidays, we visit my grandmother. She cooks for us. We eat and laugh together. I love my family.
